verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is one sentence on the Venture & Growth Tech page. It says the firm uses AI, automated translation and a blockchain-based trading platform to improve service quality, speed and security. That is close to the marketing-level mention the story explicitly wants to go beyond, and the Gide 255 and IT/digital pages describe advising clients on AI, not the firm's own use of it. Missing for 10: named AI tools or vendors, a published AI-use or governance policy, a description of how AI is applied in client matters, a named firm-owned AI or legal-tech product, and independent corroboration.
